observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== running services ==="; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'; echo; echo "=== backend process ==="; ps aux | grep green-ecolution | grep -v grep | awk '{print $11,$12,$13}'; echo; echo "=== endpoint checks ==="; for url in "http://localhost:3000/" "http://localhost:3000/api/health" "http://localhost:3000/api-docs/openapi.json"; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$url -> %{http_code}\n" "$url" --max-time 10; done; echo "http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution (auth) -> $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Host: auth.localhost' http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution --max-time 10)"; echo "http://localhost:3000/status (valhalla) -> $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Host: valhalla.localhost' http://localhost:3000/status --max-time 10)"; echo; echo "=== binaries ==="; ls -la bin/ ; /root/.cargo/bin/just --version; /root/.cargo/bin/wasm-pack --version; node --version; pnpm --version
